P2-S1 — gatebraid-capture: the evidence generator

Lands `bin/gatebraid-capture.py` and `bin/gatebraid-capture-selftest.py`
— built at M3 batch N2, corrected and dual-platform green at N2-R2 —
through gates 0–3 in the control repository (ADR-0032 decisions 1, 2
and 5). Final candidate blobs, bound at N2-R2:
`43ff5a06c7f7e1e9b0ba5d6f14e956bc8d4c73d0` (43,335 B) and
`a40869bea3d1e8dbaf20473456f919838f788eec` (40,846 B).

**Environment is `mixed-see-prose`, and this is the prose.** The
Accept-when is dual-platform by construction: every measurement runs on
Windows (CPython 3.12.2, jsonschema 4.23.0) AND WSL Ubuntu 24.04
(CPython 3.12.3, jsonschema 4.10.3), and both must be green — including
the guard-versus-Draft202012Validator cross-check, which is a real
pass/fail on both platforms (N2-R2). A gap on either platform is a stop.

**First same-repository Slice.** Phase and Slice both live in the
control repository — a configuration no gate contract has been exercised
in. Any contract clause that cannot be satisfied as written in this
configuration is a STOP and a finding under ADR-0032's first reopening
condition, never an improvisation.

**The corpus is out of scope.** Corpus v1.1 is frozen; `fixtures/` and
`schema/` are outside the allowlist, and any needed change there is an
approved N1 correct-course, not Slice work.

`depends_on` is empty: P2-S1 consumes corpus v1.1 from the base commit
of its own branch, not from any Slice's released output, and the control
repository's issues carry no dependency edges (measured, N2-G0R).

P2-S2 — the independent evidence validator (N3)

## Goal

Land M3's independent evidence validator: the tool that re-derives verdicts
from captured evidence JSON and the frozen schemas alone, publishes a
`gatebraid/coverage-report@1` classifying every verified property, and kills
the N1 corpus mutations independently of the generator (M3-PLAN §2 N3;
ADR-0031 N3-start freeze; ADR-0032 decisions 1 and 5). The script's official
name is ratified per ADR-0030 in this Slice's State Packet Approval, not
assumed here.

## Context

- Why now: N2 (P2-S1, #8) is landed and closed; the N2/N3 bootstrap boundary
  expires at N2 + N3 Gate 3 completion, and N3 re-validates N2's
  bootstrap-marked records after its own Gate 3.
- Independence: authored without reading N2's implementation — the authoring
  session receives the frozen schemas and the N1 corpus only; the
  imports-and-authorship independence review is performed by the coordinator
  from the record before freeze (M3-PLAN §2 N3).
- Non-goals: no change to any N2 file; no corpus change (IN-01 is
  re-assigned to corpus v2 at P); no O0 material; no contract, schema, ADR
  or template edit.
- Related: Stage S2 `#6` · Phase P2 `#7` · P2-S1 `#8` ·
  `schema/coverage-report.schema.json` · ADR-0028 / ADR-0030 / ADR-0031 /
  ADR-0032.

## Acceptance

- [ ] M3-PLAN §2 N3 Accept-when, in full: all applicable N1 mutations killed
      independently of N2; a deliberately corrupted N2 output rejected;
      dual-platform; the independence review (imports and authorship) on
      record; the coverage report classifies every verified property as
      `structural`, `semantic`, `replayed`, or `capture-trusted` with no
      unlabelled `replayable` credit; landed once through its own gate;
      frozen at delivery.
- [ ] Every record this Slice produces validates against the frozen
      interfaces, loader named, as part of its own evidence.

P2-S3 — gatebraid-validate repair: heuristic scope, markdown records, N2 re-validation completion

## Goal

Repair the two instrument defects `gatebraid-validate`'s first production
run exposed (friction #169, #170) and complete the N2 re-validation that
run left bounded: scope the placeholder heuristic to command and citation
fields so GraphQL inline-fragment spreads and notes-field id
abbreviations are classified as mentions, not elisions; add a
markdown-gate-record mode (`## gatebraid-metadata` extraction, the
ADR-0026 form) so all four gate records of any Slice are within the
validator's reach; then re-run the full N2 re-validation to completion
and record it — discharging the remainder the P2-S2 closure named as
owed. Files under repair: `bin/gatebraid-validate.py` and
`bin/gatebraid-validate-selftest.py` (the ratified names; no new tool,
no new name).

## Context

- Why now: the P2-S2 closure's bounded discharge (issue #10, the Closure
  Resume's verbatim passage) leaves the full mechanical re-validation of
  N2's four gate records owed until this Slice lands; O1 will rely on
  the validator over real records, so the over-match is repaired before
  the toolchain is leaned on.
- Both repairs carry their falsifications: the heuristic fix is seeded
  in both directions (a genuine elision must still reject — the
  P2-S2-closure falsification pair is the model); the markdown mode is
  seeded with a valid and an invalid embedded record.
- Non-goals: no change to `bin/gatebraid-capture*.py` (never read, only
  executed); no contract, schema, ADR, template or corpus text; no edit
  to any merged historical gate record — `gate0.json`'s nine #171-class
  citations stay recorded, not repaired.
- Related: Phase P2 `#7` · P2-S1 `#8` · P2-S2 `#10` · PR `#11` ·
  friction #169/#170/#171 · the P2-S2 Closure Resume rulings (a)–(c).

## Acceptance

- [ ] The 11 P2-S1 captures rejected at the P2-S2 closure validate
      `accepted` with the repaired heuristic, AND a genuinely elided
      capture still rejects — both shown by seeded runs, summaries
      emitted by the instrument itself.
- [ ] All four P2-S1 gate records (`gate0.json`, `gate1.md`, `gate2.md`,
      `gate3.md`) are read and verdicts emitted by the validator's own
      record mode; `gate0.json`'s nine genuine findings reproduce
      (they are the record's, not the tool's).
- [ ] The full N2 re-validation re-runs to completion on the declared
      platforms and its results are recorded in this Slice's evidence —
      the P2-S2 closure's owed remainder, discharged.
- [ ] The selftest covers both repairs and is green on both platforms;
      the frozen corpus digest is unmoved before and after.

P2-S4 — O0 snapshot/frontier hardening: the fail-closed pair

## Goal

Deliver the tool half of M3-PLAN §2 node **O0**: the hardened pair,
`bin/gatebraid-snapshot.py` and `bin/gatebraid-frontier.py`, landing in
the control repository per ADR-0032 decision 1 and implementing the O0
paragraph in full — P0-1 fail closed on auth, permission, rate-limit,
network, server, parse and unexpected-endpoint failures, with per-source
integrity status in the document; P0-2 explicit UTF-8 binary stdout, the
producer/consumer byte contract stated and tested with non-ASCII
fixtures; P0-3 every verdict-relevant connection paginated or
bounded-snapshot flags emitted, failing closed at any cap; P0-4 snapshot
schema/version required, Issue states validated against a closed enum
(unknown ⇒ `undecidable`, never unblocked), verdicts only for items
carrying Slice metadata, both dependency directions cross-checked,
declared soft dependencies parsed or the output says it did not,
Aborted/candidacy intersection per ADR-0025 §8, missing or incomplete
data ⇒ `undecidable`.

This Slice's two preconditions land **before its Gate 1, outside this
Slice, by the operator-approved batch O0-B1** (the N1 admission shape:
operator approval plus an independent read-only review before freeze):
the **snapshot-document schema** — O0's first deliverable — and the
**state-pipeline corpus**, the thirteen planned items built and frozen
against that schema (ADR-0031 decision 2), `CORPORA.json` moved
planned→built, `DETERMINACY-REPORT.md` remaining the single
classification home. This Slice consumes both frozen; it authors
neither.

## Context

- Why now: the DAG runs `{N2, N3} → O0 → O1`; the toolchain slices are
  closed (`#8`, `#10`, `#12`; PR `#13` merged) and O1 requires O0
  accepted. The unhardened M2 pair fails open (ADR-0029 decision 2,
  P0-1/P0-4, verified at source) and is not startability authority.
- Lane structure per ADR-0032 decision 2: a control-repository Slice's
  allowlist keeps the ADR-0014/0016 shape — `bin/` plus its evidence
  directory, and nothing else; schemas and the corpus are not Slice
  territory. They travel the batch lane, as every schema and fixture
  before them did (N1, N1E). The freeze-at-O0-start that ADR-0031
  decision 2 mandates is satisfied by O0-B1 preceding this Slice's
  Gate 1, so the frozen corpus precedes the implementation in commit
  history.
- The corpus digest **moves at O0-B1**, not in this Slice — the batch is
  the designed act, and it pins the new value by measurement at the
  freeze. Inside this Slice the batch-pinned digest is then held
  unmoved.
- This Slice's own Gate 0 is the state packet mechanism's **final
  enumerated use** (gate-0-contract Entry, the O0 case): full
  validation, no `bootstrap_exception`. From this Slice's Gate 3 exit
  the hardened pair is the sole startability authority.
- The M2-era tools in `MianliWang/gatebraid-scratch` are superseded
  where re-built, not moved (ADR-0032 decision 1); they remain the
  historical record and may be read as reference.
- Related: Phase P2 `#7` · P2-S1 `#8` · P2-S2 `#10` · P2-S3 `#12` ·
  PR `#13` · M3-PLAN §2 O0 · ADR-0025 §8 · ADR-0029 · ADR-0031 ·
  ADR-0032.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Both tools' outputs validate against the batch-frozen
      snapshot-document schema, schema/version required — P0-4's first
      clause demonstrated by the instruments' own summaries.
- [ ] The O0-B1 freeze precedes this Slice's implementation in commit
      history (fixtures precede the tool they test), and the
      batch-pinned corpus digest is unmoved by this Slice — both shown
      by measurement, not assertion.
- [ ] All state-pipeline fixtures pass on the declared platforms, and
      `undecidable` is demonstrably produced by **each** induced failure
      — M3-PLAN §2 O0's Accept-when, shown by seeded runs with summaries
      emitted by the instruments themselves.
- [ ] Fail-closed behaviour is demonstrated per class: each P0-1 failure
      class carries its induced case and per-source integrity status;
      P0-2's byte contract holds on non-ASCII fixtures on both
      platforms; P0-3 caps fail closed or flag; P0-4's closed enum
      yields `undecidable`, never unblocked, with both dependency
      directions cross-checked.

## Non-goals

No `schema/` or `fixtures/` write in this Slice — both are O0-B1's, the
batch lane (ADR-0032 decision 2). No edit to the four landed evidence
tools (`bin/gatebraid-capture*.py`, `bin/gatebraid-validate*.py`). No
edit to the M2 scratch copies. No O1 work (`gatebraid-ready` is O1's).
No guard or doctor work (P's). No edit to any merged historical record.
